summary: Kamada Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting its first quarter 2026 financial results, with revenue of $45.2 million (up 3% YoY), adjusted EBITDA of $11.6 million, and net income of $4.1 million. The company affirmed its 2026 annual guidance of $200–$205 million in revenue and $50–$53 million in adjusted EBITDA, expecting stronger performance in the remainder of the year. The filing also mentions evaluating near-term M&A transactions. However, this is a routine earnings release, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, activist campaign, strategic review, or corporate action triggering a special-situation classification is present in the filing.
